question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.country_id,
        m.league_id,
        m.season,
        m.home_team_api_id,
        m.away_team_api_id,
        m.home_team_goal,
        m.away_team_goal,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END AS home_points,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 0
            WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            ELSE 1
        END AS away_points
    FROM Match m
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        country_id,
        league_id,
        season,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            country_id,
            league_id,
            season,
            home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
            home_points AS points
        FROM match_points
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            country_id,
            league_id,
            season,
            away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
            away_points AS points
        FROM match_points
    )
    GROUP BY country_id, league_id, season, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        country_id,
        league_id,
        season,
        team_api_id,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_id, league_id, season ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
    FROM team_points
)
SELECT 
    c.name AS country,
    l.name AS league,
    rt.season,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    CAST(rt.total_points AS INTEGER) AS total_points
FROM ranked_teams rt
JOIN Team t ON rt.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON rt.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON rt.country_id = c.id
WHERE rt.rn = 1
ORDER BY rt.season, l.name
